name: cavemio-range-ruler
title: Range ruler
description: Two thin line needles across a graduated scale. Thumbs glide without layout thrash and repel each other on contact.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Both needles expose native button slider semantics with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuenow.
- Arrow keys step by 1 unit; Shift + Arrow or Page Up/Down step by 10 units. Home and End jump to boundary limits.
- Needle transforms and highlight widths are written directly to DOM elements during dragging to prevent React layout thrash.
- Under prefers-reduced-motion, transitions are removed and values settle immediately.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: label
props.description: – · Accessible label displayed above the ruler.

props.name: min / max / step
props.description: 0 / 100 / 1 · Lower and upper boundaries and step increment.

props.name: minDistance
props.description: 0 · Minimum allowed distance between the two needles.

props.name: unit
props.description: – · Optional unit suffix for badges and readouts (e.g. $, ms, MB).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · Fires during dragging for lightweight live previews.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: – · Fires on pointer release or keyboard adjustment.

props.name: disabled
props.description: false · Disables all interactions and cancels any active gesture.

features.title: Two needles on a scale
features.description: thin line ticks mark the axis, and the needles follow the pointer without React updates.

features.title: They push, they don’t clip
features.description: Drag one into the other and it pushes its sibling along. Set minDistance to keep a gap.

features.title: Readouts that merge
features.description: When the needles come within 48px, their two value pills glide together into one span.

features.title: Query on release
features.description: onValueChange fires while dragging for live previews, and onValueCommit fires on release or a keyboard change.

features.title: Escape cancels
features.description: Escape or an interrupted gesture restores the values from before, without committing.

features.title: Keyboard and screen readers
features.description: Arrow keys step by 1, Shift with arrows or Page Up and Down step by 10, and Home and End jump to the limits.

states.title: glide
states.description: Needles follow pointer movement directly with zero React state updates or layout recalculations.

states.title: repulsion
states.description: Dragging a needle into its sibling pushes the sibling forward or backward, keeping the range valid.

states.title: merge
states.description: When needles come within 48px, two floating metric pills glide together into a single span pill.

states.title: commit
states.description: Pointer release commits values, and NumberRoll rolls each digit to its final position over 380ms.

states.title: cancel
states.description: Escape or pointer interruption restores values from before the gesture without triggering onValueCommit.
